# Awesome AGENTS.md

> One tool-agnostic `AGENTS.md` that Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Cursor Agent all import, plus on-demand rule modules in `rules/` that an agent reads only when the task matches. The core file is always loaded and capped at 200 lines (CI-enforced); everything else is opt-in.

## Core

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the always-loaded ruleset — boundaries, security, the verification gate, workflow, debugging, the lazy-senior-dev coding ladder, communication style, commit conventions.

## Rule modules

- [rules/markdown.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/markdown.md): editing Markdown documents and articles.
- [rules/refactoring.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/refactoring.md): dedicated refactoring or cleanup passes, Chesterton's Fence, the rule of 500.
- [rules/debugging.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/debugging.md): the full debug escalation ladder — hypotheses, disproving checks, when to question the architecture.
- [rules/code-comments.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/code-comments.md): full comment policy, including public-repo safety.
- [rules/code-review.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/code-review.md): reviewing a diff/PR, severity triage, comment format, receiving review.
- [rules/testing.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/testing.md): test placement ladder, fixtures, flakiness, fuzz and property tests.
- [rules/frontend-design.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/frontend-design.md): web UI craft, accessibility numbers, motion, animation performance.
- [rules/state-management.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/state-management.md): client-side state in JS/TS — ownership ladder, persistence hygiene, SSR store lifetimes.
- [rules/web-seo.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/web-seo.md): indexability, head tags, structured data, Core Web Vitals.
- [rules/backend-security.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/backend-security.md): server and API code — auth, authorization, errors, queries, Node pitfalls.
- [rules/crypto.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/crypto.md): hashing, encryption, tokens, JWT verification, key rotation.
- [rules/database.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/database.md): schema, migrations, transactions, indexes, connection pooling.
- [rules/api-contracts.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/api-contracts.md): machine-readable API schemas, contract packages, generated clients.
- [rules/public-api-design.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/public-api-design.md): versioning, cursor pagination, idempotency keys, ETags, response caching, deprecation.
- [rules/messaging.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/messaging.md): queues, event streams, outbox, idempotent consumers, webhooks.
- [rules/payments.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/payments.md): checkout, webhook verification, idempotent fulfillment, price integrity.
- [rules/observability.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/observability.md): structured logging, health probes, metrics, graceful shutdown, env config.
- [rules/incident-response.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/incident-response.md): a live production incident — preserve evidence, contain, postmortem discipline.
- [rules/ci-cd-security.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/ci-cd-security.md): CI workflows and release automation, written against GitHub Actions — action pinning, token scope, untrusted PR input.
- [rules/dependencies.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/dependencies.md): adding or upgrading packages — lockfiles, dependency confusion, provenance.
- [rules/containers.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/containers.md): Docker/Compose/Kubernetes — multi-stage builds, non-root, secret-safe images, probes and resource limits.
- [rules/design-patterns.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/design-patterns.md): choosing design patterns — composition over inheritance, no Singleton, language-native over GoF machinery, architecture weight.
- [rules/resilience.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/resilience.md): cross-service calls — timeouts and deadline propagation, circuit breakers, retry budgets, sagas, fencing tokens, load shedding.
- [rules/rate-limiting.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/rate-limiting.md): rate limiters and quotas — algorithm choice, shared counters across instances, fail-open vs fail-closed, limit keying.
- [rules/caching.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/caching.md): caches — write-strategy selection, TTL and event invalidation, eviction policy, Redis anti-patterns, stampede protection.
- [rules/deployment.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/deployment.md): shipping to a running environment — deploy vs release, rollout strategy, feature-flag lifecycle, migration ordering.
- [rules/jobs.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/jobs.md): cron and batch work — single execution across replicas, overlap policy, idempotent reruns, missed-run policy.
- [rules/iac.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/iac.md): infrastructure as code — remote state and locking, plan review, destructive applies, drift.
- [rules/i18n.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/i18n.md): internationalization — message catalogs, plurals, RTL, locale-aware formatting and collation.
- [rules/privacy.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/privacy.md): personal data — deletion propagation, retention enforcement, PII classification, export rigor.
- [rules/shell-scripts.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/shell-scripts.md): shell scripts — bash strict mode, quoting, trap cleanup, ShellCheck, PowerShell strict mode.
- [rules/git-hooks.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/git-hooks.md): pre-commit gates with husky and lint-staged.
- [rules/monorepo.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/monorepo.md): pnpm/npm workspaces, Turborepo, Nx.
- [rules/llm-agents.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/llm-agents.md): building LLM and agent features — Rule of Two, indirect prompt injection, tool least privilege.
- [rules/memory.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/memory.md): persistent agent memory hygiene.
- [rules/mobile.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/mobile.md): Android and iOS — keystore storage, pinning, exported components, release hardening.
- [rules/nextjs.md](https://github.com/khasky/awesome-agents-md/blob/main/rules/nextjs.md): Next.js App Router — server/client boundary, Server Actions, route handlers.

## Docs
